verdict.rationale: Circle's docs describe integration through REST APIs and Web/Mobile SDKs, with key custody handled by Circle via MPC or passkeys. Gas can be sponsored by the developer or paid in USDC, and Gateway offers a chain-abstracted USDC balance, so the core abstraction of chain mechanics behind a conventional API is clearly documented. Bridge Kit, idempotency keys and webhooks add to the conventional-API experience. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that developers never run or connect to nodes; evidence of server-side client libraries in common backend languages (only Web, Android and iOS SDKs are cited); independent or hands-on corroboration.
